title: Project Team Formation Guidelines
content:
Dear Students,

Please read and strictly follow the team formation guidelines before submitting your project groups:

• Each team must contain 4–5 students.
• All members must belong to the same academic batch (2026-2028).
• Every member must have a unique roll number and institutional email.
• Each student can belong to only one team in the course.
• Students must select a topic from the faculty-approved list in Resources.
• Project proposals must be submitted before the faculty-defined deadline (25 Oct 2026).

Project proposal format and evaluation criteria are attached below. Contact the course instructor during office hours for topic approvals.

title: Updated REST & GraphQL API Specification Standards
content: All teams developing web service microservices must use OpenAPI 3.0 / YAML specifications for API contracts. Docker-compose configuration for service discovery must be committed to your team repository by Milestone 1.

title: Team Formation Deadline Extended
content: The deadline for algorithm capstone project groups has been extended to 28 Oct 2026. Review benchmark dataset resources.

title: Submit Project Proposal Format
content: Submit your database schema proposals using the approved institute format.

title: Sprint Planning Session Schedule
content: Sprint 1 planning sessions will occur next week during lab hours.
